newProduct.useRealAgentsHint: Off by default (uses fast, free mock agents). Turn this on to run the real LLM-backed agents -- requires LLM_API_KEY/LLM_MODEL (and SILAH_OPENAI_API_KEY for scoring) set on the server. If they're not configured you'll get a clear error, not a silent fallback. This choice is remembered on this device, so it stays on for discovery, drafting and re-drafting until you turn it off again.
